blocks.text: QIS College of Engineering & Technology ensures quality Teaching-learning process, Research, Outreach services, societal commitments with high ethical values and Leadership in Technical & Professional Education by imparting the high quality education. It is dedicated to nurture a culture of continuous quality improvement and optimum utilization of resources to achieve academic excellence.
QUALITY MEANS DOING IT RIGHT WHEN NO ONE IS LOOKING.
